head: 5bfe51f4243f373cebc5b873439b3087de8885d3
title: fix(coach-ai): Save edits on AI workout and meal drafts is accepted (AUDIT-14-125)
body:
Tier: T2
Why: one class-validator decorator on a coach-only request DTO; the route, guards, ownership check and merge logic are unchanged.
T4 trigger scan: none (no auth/guard change, no RLS/tenancy, money, PII, credentials or destructive data; CoachAIService.editDraft still checks draft.coachId === caller and status DRAFT).
T3 trigger scan: none beyond an AI draft edit body contract.
Bounded T1: NO (request contract on an AI surface).
Canonical builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (AUDIT-14-125, agent 125)
Parent owner: operator agent 125
Acceptance evidence: test/coach-ai-edit-draft-dto.spec.ts runs the production ValidationPipe options against EditDraftDto: on main the app's `{ patch }` body is refused (1 failed); with this change it passes and the patch reaches the service intact; non-object patch and unknown keys are still refused. Full suite + tsc in this PR's CI.
Promotion triggers: any change to editDraft's ownership or status checks.

## Fixes

**U3 — "Save edits" on AI workout and meal drafts always fails.** A coach edits sets or a meal in an AI draft and taps Save edits (or "Save and approve"), and always sees "Save failed": the app posts `{ patch }`, and `EditDraftDto.patch` (src/ai/coach/coach-ai.dto.ts) had no class-validator decorator, so the global ValidationPipe (`whitelist` + `forbidNonWhitelisted`, src/main.ts) rejected it with 400 "property patch should not exist". Fix: `@IsObject()` on `patch`.

Mobile side needs no change (mobile already sends `{ patch }`); companion mobile PR for the rest of AUDIT-14: growth-project-mobile#425.

Size: 36 changed lines, tests included.
